I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed his correction: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 84 seats. He said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I didn't read #central-team or anything else, and I didn't change the earlier post. I told him he'd need to correct that post in #central-team himself if he wants the people there to see the right number.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, so repeating it in the channel was fine.
